messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care! How are things going this week — any blood pressure readings to share, or changes since last time?
Not great. I ran out of lisinopril three days ago and I can't get to the pharmacy. Truck's in the shop and it's like 80 miles round trip anyway.

Really sorry you're in that spot. I can't arrange transport or handle refills from here — I wish I could, and I know that's frustrating to hear. But being off lisinopril for three days is something your nurse needs to know about. Flagging it for your care team right now. Median response time is currently 31 hours, so expect a call.
Alright. Took my BP this morning just to see — 158 over 94. Probably not good.
Logged that reading. That's higher than your usual range and I've added it to the nurse note so they have the full picture. Anything else going on — headache, dizziness, chest tightness?
Mild headache most of the day. Figured it was stress. This whole situation is exhausting.

That makes complete sense, and I'm sorry you're dealing with it. I've included the headache in the nurse flag — they'll have everything. If anything gets significantly worse before they reach you, please call 911. I'll set your next check-in for next week. Hang in there.

theme: the long drive to the pharmacy or clinic, transport
